disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on ports, so it does not involve local unauthenticated RPC risk. Runtime dynamic sandbox verification (DG-L4) is not enabled.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动 web 服务或监听端口，不涉及本机无认证 RPC 面。该场景属 dsh 宿主固有风险，与插件无关。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on ports, so it does not involve a local unauthenticated RPC surface. This scenario is an inherent risk of the dsh host and is unrelated to the plugin.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份检查通过。package.json 含 dsh 声明，依赖 dsh SDK，cordis.patch.yml 有效。作者账号未验证，记录但不足为风险。
summary.en: Metadata and identity checks passed. package.json contains the dsh declaration, depends on the dsh SDK, and cordis.patch.yml is valid. The author account is unverified; this is recorded but is not enough to constitute a risk.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成。32 条机械命中全部逐条裁决并确认为良性：cordis.patch.yml 无 !!js 标量；child_process 用于 CLI 工具调用（经 DSH 审批管道）；prepare 为编译脚本；client credentials.set 为用户主动设置界面；所有 .map 文件为构建产物；文档提及的 curl 和 .credentials.yaml 为设计说明非实际执行代码。无任何恶意或高风险模式。
summary.en: Static scan completed. All 32 mechanical hits were individually adjudicated and confirmed benign: cordis.patch.yml has no !!js scalars; child_process is used for CLI tool invocation (through the DSH approval pipeline); the prepare script is a compilation script; the client credentials.set is a user-initiated settings UI; all .map files are build artifacts; the curl and .credentials.yaml mentions in documentation are design descriptions, not actual executed code. No malicious or high-risk patterns.

summary.zh: 行为分析完成。install 钩子仅为编译脚本，无远程执行或网络操作。无混淆/base64 载荷。无凭据文件读取。外联域名均为公开搜索后端 API。无凭证+外泄组合链。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis completed. The install hook is only a compilation script, with no remote execution or network operations. No obfuscation/base64 payloads. No credential file reads. Outbound domains are all public search backend APIs. No credential + exfiltration combination chain.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查完成。工具描述和 systemPrompt 段语义分析确认无注入意图。能力声明与观测面一致。无 tool shadowing。
summary.en: AI metadata review completed. Semantic analysis of tool descriptions and the systemPrompt segment confirms no injection intent. Capability declarations match the observed surface. No tool shadowing.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed in this phase.

limits.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（DG-L4）。所有 32 条 static-scan 机械命中已逐条裁决（DSH-X07→DG-R3-59、DSH-C01→DG-R1-51、DSH-C05→DG-R4-53、DSH-X08→DG-R3-60 共 15 条、DSH-X05→DG-R3-57 共 3 条、DSH-T02→DG-R2-52 共 2 条、DSH-X03→DG-R3-55 共 3 条、DSH-X02→DG-R3-54），经分析确认均为良性——文档引用、构建产物、正常功能代码或标准 CI 流程，不落入 findings。审计范围覆盖整个仓库根目录（插件在此）。
limits.en: No dynamic sandbox verification (DG-L4) was performed. All 32 static-scan mechanical hits were individually adjudicated (DSH-X07→DG-R3-59, DSH-C01→DG-R1-51, DSH-C05→DG-R4-53, DSH-X08→DG-R3-60 with 15 hits, DSH-X05→DG-R3-57 with 3 hits, DSH-T02→DG-R2-52 with 2 hits, DSH-X03→DG-R3-55 with 3 hits, DSH-X02→DG-R3-54), and analysis confirmed they are all benign — documentation references, build artifacts, normal functional code, or standard CI pipelines, not falling into findings. Audit scope covers the entire repository root (where the plugin resides).
